name: DeepSeek Harness for Win v1.1.0
body:
## Features / 主要更新

- Replaced the release-notes drawer with a centered card-style Update Hub with fixed Header/Footer and a locally scrolling Body. / 将更新日志侧滑抽屉升级为居中卡片式更新中心，采用固定 Header/Footer 与局部滚动 Body。
- Added transaction-aware update states, SemVer-sorted accordion history, release badge summaries, and a compact About view. / 新增事务状态更新卡、SemVer 倒序手风琴时间线、改动徽标统计和精简关于页。
- Unified SemVer 2.0 parser and precedence comparator across JavaScript runtime, CLI, and PowerShell updater scripts. / 在 JavaScript 运行时、CLI 与 PowerShell 更新脚本中统一实现了 SemVer 2.0 解析器与优先级比较器。

## Improvements / 优化提升

- Preserved live and persisted update status when the Update Hub is closed and reopened, including progress and rollback availability. / 关闭并重新打开更新中心时保留实时与持久化更新状态，包括进度和回滚入口。
- Added Escape/backdrop dismissal, focus trapping, responsive narrow-window sizing, reduced-motion handling, and runtime light/dark theme synchronization. / 新增 Escape/遮罩关闭、焦点陷阱、窄窗口自适应、减少动态效果支持与运行时深浅主题同步。
- Kept cached release history and update actions available while remote release data refreshes in the background. / 远端发布数据后台刷新期间继续使用缓存版本历史，并保持更新操作可用。

## Fixes / 修复

- Wired the Update Hub rollback action to the existing transactional rollback entry point. / 修复更新中心回滚按钮未接入事务回滚入口的问题。
- Kept release packaging guarded by strict runtime source-consistency checks and generated checksums. / 保留发布前运行时源码一致性校验与校验和生成门禁。
